videos.title: Bilateral, Machine Defined Chest Press - Cybex Eagle Chest Press
videos.description:
1) Take a comfortable grip on the handles with your wrists roughly aligned with your elbows.

2) Push both handles forward until your arms are straight in front of you.

3) Return to the starting position and repeat.

Visit us at http://www.cybexintl.com

videos.title: Unilateral, Machine Defined Chest Press - Cybex Eagle Chest Press
videos.description:
1)  Take a comfortable grip on one handle with your wrist roughly aligned with your elbow.

2)  Push the handle forward until your arm is straight in front of you.

3)  Return to the starting position and repeat for several repetitions before switching to the opposite side.
